one_liner: Diagnoses and treats illness — the person you see when something is wrong.
job_roles: General Physician | Surgeon | Paediatrician | Gynaecologist | Psychiatrist | Anaesthesiologist | Radiologist | Pathologist | Emergency Medicine Physician | Cardiologist
ai_reason: Diagnostic support is improving fast and will change the work, but a registered human must examine, decide and carry liability. Physical examination and procedures are not text problems.
role_spread: [Psychiatrist, General Physician] higher: emotional_intelligence, verbal, agreeableness / lower: spatial, bodily
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology AND English, with 50 percent in PCB -> entrance_exam: NEET UG. Minimum age 17, no upper age limit, no cap on attempts. -> degree: MBBS (4.5 years) at an NMC-recognised college -> internship: Compulsory 12-month rotating internship (CRMI) -> registration: Register with a State Medical Council — mandatory to practise -> specialisation: NEET PG then MD/MS for a specialist career (3 more years)
review_reason: The bimodal cost is the single most consequential number in this dataset and the schema cannot express it — one field, two realities 20x apart. Verify actual government vs private MBBS fee ranges and decide how to present them before shipping.
nuances: [economics] Cost is BIMODAL, not a range. A government seat costs roughly 1-5 lakh for the whole degree; a private or deemed seat costs 60 lakh to 1.2 crore. The figure shown is a blend and describes almost nobody. Which side of that line a student lands on is decided entirely by their NEET rank. || [class12_prerequisite] There is NO private bypass. Unlike engineering, money cannot open a door NEET has closed — the same eligibility applies to government, private and deemed colleges alike. || [entry_window] Null because NEET has no upper age limit and no cap on attempts. A commerce graduate is not permanently blocked — they can add PCB through NIOS and sit NEET at any age. It is a long cost, roughly 8 years, not a closed door.

one_liner: Treats teeth and gums — fillings, extractions, braces and oral surgery.
job_roles: General Dentist | Orthodontist | Endodontist | Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon | Periodontist | Prosthodontist | Paedodontist
ai_reason: Almost entirely manual work inside a patient's mouth, with a licensed human carrying liability. Treatment planning software is exposed; the hands are not.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with 50 percent in PCB -> entrance_exam: NEET UG -> degree: BDS (4 years) -> internship: Compulsory 1-year rotating internship -> registration: Register with a State Dental Council under the Dental Council of India
review_reason: KNOWN OVERSUPPLY. India produces far more BDS graduates than the market absorbs, and a large share end up underemployed or move into non-clinical work. The salary band shown may flatter the typical outcome. Verify before recommending, and consider whether it needs a warning rather than a straight listing.

one_liner: Treats patients using Ayurveda — India's traditional system of medicine.
job_roles: Ayurveda Physician | Panchakarma Specialist | Ayurvedic Surgeon (Shalya) | Kayachikitsa Specialist | Unani Physician | Siddha Physician
licensing_body: National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM)
ai_reason: Clinical examination and hands-on therapies are physical, and a registered practitioner carries legal responsibility. Classical text lookup is exposed; deciding what a specific patient needs is not.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English -> entrance_exam: NEET UG -> degree: BAMS, BUMS or BSMS (5.5 years including internship) -> registration: Register with a State Board under the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine

one_liner: Treats patients using homeopathy.
job_roles: Homeopathic Physician | Consultant Homeopath | Homeopathic Paediatric Practitioner
ai_reason: Long consultations built on listening and case-taking. A registered practitioner is legally accountable for the patient.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English -> entrance_exam: NEET UG -> degree: BHMS (5.5 years including internship) -> registration: Register with a State Board under the National Commission for Homoeopathy

one_liner: Treats animals — pets, livestock and wildlife.
job_roles: Veterinary Surgeon | Livestock Veterinary Officer | Small Animal Practitioner | Veterinary Pathologist | Wildlife Veterinarian | Poultry & Dairy Health Officer
ai_reason: Physical examination of animals that cannot describe symptoms, plus surgery and field work in livestock settings. A registered vet is legally accountable.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English -> entrance_exam: NEET UG for the all-India quota; state and ICAR entrances also apply -> degree: B.V.Sc & A.H. (5.5 years including internship) -> registration: Register with a State Veterinary Council under the Veterinary Council of India
review_reason: Veterinary admission has moved between NEET and ICAR AIEEA and varies by state. Verify the current route before shipping.

one_liner: Cares for patients around the clock — the person who is actually there.
job_roles: Staff Nurse | ICU / Critical Care Nurse | Operation Theatre Nurse | Paediatric Nurse | Community Health Nurse | Nurse Educator | Midwife
ai_reason: Overwhelmingly physical and present-tense — lifting, monitoring, administering, noticing a patient deteriorate before a monitor does. A registered nurse is legally accountable.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English -> entrance_exam: State nursing entrances or CUET; some states use NEET -> degree: B.Sc Nursing (4 years), or GNM diploma (3 years) -> registration: Register with a State Nursing Council and the Indian Nursing Council — mandatory to practise
review_reason: Nursing entrance routes vary by state and some states have moved to NEET. Verify. Also confirm the salary band — Indian nursing pay is widely reported as low relative to workload, and the band may be optimistic for private hospitals.
nuances: [demand_signal] One of very few professions in this dataset where working abroad is a mainstream, well-established path rather than an exception. Gulf, UK and Ireland actively recruit Indian nurses, and pay differs several-fold.

one_liner: Dispenses medicines and checks they are safe to take together.
job_roles: Community Pharmacist | Hospital Pharmacist | Clinical Pharmacist | Industrial Pharmacist | Drug Safety Associate | Regulatory Affairs Executive
ai_reason: Drug interaction lookup is the most automatable part and is already software-assisted. What remains is a registered human legally responsible for what is dispensed, plus counselling patients who did not understand what the doctor said.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics and Chemistry, plus Biology or Maths -> entrance_exam: State pharmacy entrances or CUET -> degree: B.Pharm (4 years) or D.Pharm (2 years) -> registration: Register with a State Pharmacy Council — mandatory to practise
nuances: [class12_prerequisite] Unlike almost every other clinical profession here, B.Pharm accepts PCM as well as PCB. A maths-stream student who missed biology can still enter pharmacy.

one_liner: Helps people move again after injury, surgery or illness.
job_roles: Physiotherapist | Sports Physiotherapist | Neuro Physiotherapist | Orthopaedic Physiotherapist | Cardiopulmonary Physiotherapist | Paediatric Physiotherapist
ai_reason: Hands on a body, adjusting in real time to what it does. Among the least automatable professions in the entire dataset — the treatment IS physical contact.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English -> entrance_exam: CUET or state allied-health entrances -> degree: BPT (4.5 years including internship) -> registration: Register with the Physiotherapy Professional Council under the NCAHP Act 2021
nuances: [licensing_body] Newly regulated. The NCAHP Act 2021 moved physiotherapy from an unregulated field to one where practice without registration is prohibited. Implementation is still rolling out state by state.

one_liner: Tests eyesight and prescribes glasses and contact lenses.
job_roles: Optometrist | Contact Lens Practitioner | Vision Therapist | Low Vision Specialist | Ophthalmic Technician | Refractionist
ai_reason: Autorefractors already automate measurement, but subjective refraction is a conversation with a patient about what they can actually see, and a registered practitioner signs the prescription.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology -> entrance_exam: CUET or state allied-health entrances -> degree: B.Optom / B.Sc Optometry (4 years including internship) -> registration: Register with the Ophthalmic Science Professional Council under the NCAHP Act 2021

one_liner: Helps people who cannot hear well or struggle to speak.
job_roles: Audiologist | Speech-Language Pathologist | Cochlear Implant Audiologist | Early Intervention Therapist | Hearing Aid Specialist
ai_reason: Therapy is repeated human interaction over months, often with children. Diagnostic audiometry is partly automated; teaching a child to speak is not.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology -> entrance_exam: AIISH entrance or CUET -> degree: BASLP (4 years including internship) -> registration: Register with the Rehabilitation Council of India — mandatory to practise

one_liner: Helps people relearn everyday tasks after injury, stroke or disability.
job_roles: Occupational Therapist | Paediatric Occupational Therapist | Hand Therapist | Mental Health Occupational Therapist | Rehabilitation Specialist
ai_reason: Hands-on rehabilitation adapted to one person's home, job and body. Physical and highly individual.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology -> entrance_exam: CUET or state allied-health entrances -> degree: BOT (4.5 years including internship) -> registration: Register under the NCAHP Act 2021

one_liner: Plans what patients should eat to manage illness and stay well.
job_roles: Clinical Dietitian | Sports Nutritionist | Renal Dietitian | Paediatric Nutritionist | Community Nutrition Officer | Food Service Dietitian
ai_reason: Diet chart generation is heavily automatable and already commoditised by apps. What survives is getting a real person to actually change what they eat — clarity and behaviour change, not calculation.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Biology, or Home Science with a science subject -> entrance_exam: CUET or university entrances -> degree: B.Sc Nutrition & Dietetics (3 years) -> internship: Hospital dietetic internship -> registration: Register under the NCAHP Act 2021

one_liner: Runs the blood and sample tests doctors rely on to diagnose.
job_roles: Medical Laboratory Technologist | Histopathology Technician | Microbiology Lab Technician | Blood Bank Technician | Biochemistry Lab Technologist | Phlebotomist
ai_reason: Analysers automate the measurement, but samples must be physically drawn, prepared and handled, and a registered technologist signs the report. Histopathology in particular remains manual.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology -> training: B.Sc MLT (3 years) or DMLT diploma (2 years) -> registration: Register under the NCAHP Act 2021
nuances: [professional_sector] Sits in Healthcare, not Science & Research, because the work is clinical diagnosis for a named patient. The research-lab equivalent is Laboratory Technician in Sector 3.

one_liner: Operates X-ray, CT and MRI machines to take images inside the body.
job_roles: Radiographer | CT Technologist | MRI Technologist | Ultrasound Technician | Radiotherapy Technologist | Cath Lab Technologist
ai_reason: AI reads images well and will keep improving — but that is the RADIOLOGIST's task, not this one. Positioning a frightened patient, running the machine safely and managing radiation dose stay physical and human.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology -> training: B.Sc Radiology & Imaging Technology (3-4 years) or a diploma -> registration: Register under the NCAHP Act 2021

one_liner: Prepares the operating theatre and assists during surgery.
job_roles: Operation Theatre Technologist | Anaesthesia Technologist | Surgical Technologist | CSSD Technician | Perfusionist
ai_reason: Sterile technique, instrument handling and machine setup inside a live operating theatre. Entirely physical, high consequence, and legally accountable.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology -> training: B.Sc OT & Anaesthesia Technology (3-4 years) or a diploma -> registration: Register under the NCAHP Act 2021

one_liner: Runs dialysis and life-support machines for very ill patients.
job_roles: Dialysis Technologist | Critical Care Technologist | Renal Replacement Technician | Ventilator Technician | ECMO Technician
ai_reason: Machine operation beside a patient whose life depends on it, for hours at a time. Physical, monitored and legally accountable.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Physics, Chemistry, Biology -> training: B.Sc Dialysis / Critical Care Technology (3 years) or a diploma -> registration: Register under the NCAHP Act 2021

one_liner: First to reach an emergency — keeps people alive on the way to hospital.
job_roles: Emergency Medical Technician | Ambulance Paramedic | Advanced Life Support Technician | Emergency Room Technician | Disaster Response Medic
ai_reason: Physical, unpredictable and time-critical. Decisions made in minutes with incomplete information at a roadside. Nothing about it is a text problem.
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Science stream with Biology -> training: Certificate or B.Sc in Emergency Medical Technology (6 months to 3 years) -> certification: BLS and ACLS certification -> registration: Register under the NCAHP Act 2021
review_reason: Lowest-paid profession in this sector and physically and emotionally demanding. Confirm the salary band and whether it is a durable career or mainly a route into nursing.

one_liner: Installs and repairs the machines a hospital runs on.
job_roles: Biomedical Equipment Technician | Hospital Equipment Maintenance Technician | Medical Device Service Engineer | Calibration Technician | Equipment Installation Specialist
ai_reason: Physical repair and calibration of equipment inside hospitals. A machine that is down must be attended in person.
path_to_entry: class_10_12: Science stream -> training: Diploma or B.Sc in Biomedical Equipment Technology (2-3 years) -> employment: Hospitals, device distributors and service companies hire directly -> progression: Manufacturer certification on specific equipment is what raises pay
nuances: [professional_sector] Sits in Healthcare rather than Engineering because the work happens inside clinical care delivery. The B.Tech design-side role is Biomedical Engineer in Sector 2.

one_liner: Turns doctors' notes into the standard codes hospitals and insurers use.
job_roles: Medical Coder | Medical Biller | Clinical Documentation Specialist | Health Information Technician | Medical Records Officer | Claims Analyst (health)
ai_reason: THE MOST AI-EXPOSED PROFESSION IN THIS SECTOR by a wide margin. The work is mapping documented text to a code set using rules — retrievable knowledge plus digital execution, with almost no physical or clarity component. Auditing and denial management survive longer than routine coding.
path_to_entry: class_12: Any stream; a life-science background helps -> degree: Any bachelor's — B.Sc life sciences, nursing, pharmacy and BPT are common -> certification: CPC or CCS certification is the actual hiring gate -> employment: Healthcare BPOs and hospital revenue-cycle teams hire directly
review_reason: Very high AI exposure in a sector where everything else is protected. This is a large Indian employment category — healthcare BPOs employ hundreds of thousands — so calling it exposed is a consequential claim. It is also one of very few healthcare careers open to a non-PCB student, which makes removing it costly for that audience. Needs a human decision.

one_liner: Works on the health of whole populations, not one patient at a time.
job_roles: Epidemiologist | Public Health Officer | Programme Manager (health) | Health Policy Analyst | Disease Surveillance Officer | Community Health Specialist | Biostatistician (public health)
entrance_exams: CUET PG | Institute entrances (IIPH, AIIMS, TISS)
ai_reason: Data analysis is exposed. Deciding which population question matters, and persuading a government to act on it, is not.
role_spread: [Epidemiologist, Biostatistician (public health)] higher: logical, reasoning, attention_span / lower: extraversion, emotional_intelligence
path_to_entry: class_12: Any stream -> degree: Any bachelor's — MBBS, BDS, nursing, life sciences, statistics and social sciences all feed in -> post_graduate: MPH (Master of Public Health) — this is the real entry qualification -> employment: Government health programmes, WHO and UN agencies, NGOs, research institutes
nuances: [mid_stream_entry] One of the most reachable healthcare careers for a non-PCB student. The MPH accepts graduates from statistics, social sciences and management — no NEET, no biology at class 12, no clinical degree required.
